nodes.name: Read input file
nodes.notes: Stands in for the Gmail trigger: puts the sample file on binary property attachment_0, the same place the real trigger puts the email attachment.

nodes.name: Read xlsx attachment
nodes.notes: Assumes a single .xlsx attachment, which Gmail Trigger exposes as binary property 'attachment_0' (its standard naming for the first attachment on an item).

parameters.query: SELECT sku, qty FROM stock WHERE substr(sku, 4) = $1 ORDER BY sku;

nodes.name: Look up stock
nodes.notes: Runs once per incoming SKU row (main input = 'Read xlsx attachment'). substr(sku, 4) strips the 3-digit prefix, matching on the 8-digit product body shared by a product's 300/310/400 codes. Returns 0-3 rows per SKU.

parameters.query: SELECT prefix, stage, next_step, check_order FROM routing ORDER BY check_order;

nodes.name: Read routing rules
nodes.notes: executeOnce: true -- the routing table is small and fixed, so this runs once regardless of how many stock rows 'Look up stock' passes through.

nodes.name: Decide next step
nodes.notes: The one required Code node. Pure decideNextStep()/buildStockIndex() logic is above the GLUE marker and is unit-tested directly from this file by tests/routing.test.js. Throws (does not guess) if the Routing-rules read failed or came back malformed; a SKU simply absent from the stock sheet instead returns the row-level 'SKU NOT FOUND' and processing continues.

nodes.name: Write result file
nodes.notes: Stands in for the Gmail reply: writes the built xlsx to test-output/<input name>-result.xlsx.
